entry.title: Motion to remove Luke Dashjr from BIP Editors
entry.summary:
The ongoing issues with Luke Dashjr's contributions to the Bitcoin community have been a point of contention for many years. His behavior, often described as toxic, includes accusations without evidence, failure to explain his viewpoints adequately, and revising history to favor his narrative. This has been observed since the time of Gavin Andresen's leadership in the community. Luke has attempted to pass off a modified fork as the official Bitcoin Core package for Gentoo, which is misleading and unethical. Moreover, his attempt to block Taproot's authors from documenting their deployment mechanism showcases his preference for personal influence over community consensus.
Additionally, Luke has misused Bitcoin Core's translation resources for his project and even tried a hostile takeover of the repository when opposed. His baseless accusations against fellow contributors and filing of CVEs against common judgments further illustrate his disregard for collaborative and ethical development practices. He labels Bitcoin Core as malware when decisions do not align with his views, while presenting his Bitcoin Knots as a legitimate iteration of Bitcoin Core, thereby leveraging its reputation.
His misleading representation of his soft fork's prospects and the continuous instigation of harassment campaigns highlight a pattern of behavior unbecoming of a collaborative developer. Despite his earlier contributions, his recent actions have stalled progress in the BIPs repository and claimed undue credit for others' work, proving to be more detrimental than beneficial to the Bitcoin ecosystem. It's evident that his approach and actions have consistently hindered rather than helped the community, leading to a decisive call for dissociation from his projects and acknowledging his separate path with his own forkcoin, Bpedo. For further reading on these incidents, refer to discussions and evidences found on various platforms, including [BitcoinTalk](https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=62037.0), [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/Bitcoin/comments/2pfgjg/exposed_lukejr_plans_on_forcing_blacklists_on_all/), [Bitcoin Magazine](https://bitcoinmagazine.com/technical/lottrue-or-lotfalse-this-is-the-last-hurdle-before-taproot-activation), and other sources.
